input.query: SELECT app_version, platform, doc_type, COUNT(*) attempts, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) approval_rate, MIN(event_date) first_date, MAX(event_date) last_date FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
